seoTitle: Work with me — Ojobo Agbo Eje
seoDescription: Work with Ojobo Agbo Eje to find valuable AI use cases, redesign workflows, build practical solutions, train teams, or bring a speaker to your event.
text_002: Turn AI ambition into measurable value
text_003: I help professionals, businesses, institutions, and organizations find the right opportunities, redesign work, build solutions, and develop the capability to sustain change. We start with the outcome you need, not a tool to buy.
text_006: Start with your outcome, not a predefined tool
text_007: Choose the route that fits your immediate need. These are starting points, not fixed packages; we can define the scope, deliverables, and measures of success together.
text_010: For leaders facing slow processes, avoidable effort, missed opportunities, or an AI initiative without a clear business case.
text_011: We examine the current process, prioritize use cases, identify the skills and technology required, and set out how to test value before scaling. The result is a clearer decision about what to do next and how to measure it.
text_013: A prioritized use-case shortlist, a redesigned workflow, a pilot plan, and measures for judging whether the change works.
text_016: Implement a solution people can use
text_017: For teams with a real problem that needs a usable interface, data product, or platform, not only a strategy document.
text_018: We can build or implement a data product, focused application, automation, or integration, then test it in the workflow it is meant to improve.
text_020: I conceived and led CHEDVI, a public-facing platform for exploring neighborhood health-equity patterns in Camden.
text_024: Train people to use AI well
text_025: For professionals and teams that need more than tool demonstrations: practical skills, shared understanding, and confidence in where AI should and should not fit.
text_026: Choose a leadership briefing, team workshop, or longer capability series shaped around your people, workflows, and stage of adoption.
text_029: Create a better conversation about AI, work, and business
text_030: For conferences, leadership groups, and professional communities that want practical ideas on AI transformation, adoption, work, and human judgment.
text_033: Tell me what you are trying to change
text_034: Tell me the outcome you want, who the work affects, and what you have tried. I will use that context to see where I can contribute and what a sensible first step could be.
